content:
Context: Exception-

- 22-A. Regardless of amount involved, where the transaction regarding the material purchases or contract for any repairs or minor construction to an immovable property, is with a person with whom the Government servant concerned has official dealings. Intimation is necessary to incur expenditure on repairs and minor additions to an immovable property with the estimate exceeding two months' Basic Pay. - GID (29), Rule 18.
